findings.description: put_stream writes the full upload to a file under incoming/ and only moves it into place with os.replace on the create path. When target.exists() is true, the function returns early at line 66 without removing the incoming file, so every duplicate upload leaves a full-size copy behind in the incoming directory. Because the content is already stored, these orphaned files accumulate without bound and consume disk space, and the pre-change code did not have this problem.
findings.suggestion: Remove the temporary file before returning on the dedup path, for example by calling incoming.unlink(missing_ok=True) before the early return, or restructure so the cleanup runs in a finally block whenever the file was not moved.
findings.title: Uploaded temp file is leaked when the blob already exists
